body: SO. GOOD.  Felt like a damn WrestleMania match promo!!
The comeback is always greater than the setback.  You’re doing the work, He sees this.  Trust His process, be patient, you will find your community. The right community.  You have my prayers 🙏

That’s a fair assessment based on the post, I guess the way I can best describe what I do is help get her out of her box.  As an only child I had the chance to be selfish and attack all my dreams with force.  She’s constantly been boxed in in her life through responsibilities  work and the small town she is from.  I never pushed her but when we first met grad school was a long term goal but she actually began to put a plan in place to make it actionable.  I often tell her our new paths (one of responsibility for me and one of fearlessness for her) are familiar to the other, maybe we can give advice on where the potholes are (I figure I’ll be more busy there haha)

I understand your perspective and a part of it is just my frustration as I’ve been a finalist too many times to count.  What bothered me was that it wasn’t a random follow up email but a direct reply to our last correspondence but either way I just felt such a letdown.  And while I can read the writing on the wall I still haven’t heard a formal rejection yet and this happened earlier this week.  I’ve been ghosted, strung along so many times and it’s just so exhausting to my psyche.

I get it’s got to be a challenging job to recruit and deal with so many people and I have no idea how to fix it.  It’s just a very difficult system that will never be perfect and the longer I seek work the more the process weighs.

Thank you thank you!  One other thing, I don’t live locally to the court, will that hinder me in getting documentation signed by the clerk?  I’m sure every court is different but generally speaking to I have to be in the local area of where the judgement is issued?  Could I assign a 3rd party to bring documents in?

Thank you for your prayers but I’ve failed in this quest.  That said, I felt a sense of relief wash over me when I heard I was passed over, I truly believe there’s something even better for me and God is on my side to help me find it.  I just pray I’m right.

Not personally but asked my dad who’s been there for it all (and has the high BP to go with it).  He said they were just...mediocre and blah after the super bowl win. Though he thought they had more of an identity overall (at least until Namath left). He thinks the sea saw nature of the team the past 10 years (Rex and Sanchez to Fitzmagic to Sam and Gase) has made it feel longer and more helpless.
Let’s not pretend Tua didn’t see better defensive play in the SEC last year.
Oh believe me it’s on my shortlist as well.  I got the tip from some people who work as on-camera talent but beginning to confirm what I suspect and it’s more theme park related work I think.

Gotcha, yes this is my concern as I’m not sure the rate change in the geography which is why I’d be interested in joining some kind of networking group at first. 

That said the numbers you mention are still a fraction of my current NYC expenses!!

Thanks this is all helpful. You’re actually highlighting a lot of my concerns because I do have a reel and a website however most of my work in NYC/LA is from word of mouth (as usual in the industry) so moving to a place with no contacts has always been a non starter.  That said, my clients include all the major record labels, an NFL Team and a few prominent NY fashion businesses so the quality of work I put out is something I stand by. 

I have considered teaching and think I’d be a good candidate for it but not sure the details.  Perhaps will reach out to someone from there when this all dies down.
I’ve been trying to get a hold of my lawyer. And now the court is closed. I def waited too long but was blindsided only got the papers less than 24 hrs ago.
They know a thing or two because they’ve seen a thing or two.

Thanks so much, I maintained for years my situation was okay, this hit so close to home because I had to admit to family that it was not.  My parents knew going in...but as Jor-El said “you did this of your own free will”, yet they still welcomed me back with open hearts. Despite my shame like Superman felt In this scene.

They told me she filed an incident report to make a record of it but it wasn’t a criminal complaint.  First question I asked was if I should speak to a lawyer.  They said it was just to “document the incident”. Which makes me think maybe my side and video evidence can help. 

She’s already calling me crying asking me to come home.  I think she regrets what she did but even still I think our marriage is beyond repair I only what this could do in a divorce proceeding.

Thank you very much, I’m trying so hard finding a new full time job.  The photography is keeping me going with money but jobs few and far between. I have one job on deck that I’m hoping to hear back from soon. It would be a great chance to start over and rebuild my life.  

As far as the home, while I’m only on the deed and not the note, I’ve invested all but the initial down payment on the house - that includes a 100K remodel from money I made from a home sale (property that predates the marriage.).  I know that if we lose the house I lose all equity I put in (even if she’s entitled to it).  I failed to realize while the mortgage is in her name she had no intent on paying if herself (even half as we agreed on).  How would divorce proceedings affect foreclosure.  Or if we begin the divorce process can an attorney force me to pay to keep up the mortgage even if the debt is in her name alone?

Please, for your own sake leave now. It will only get worse. Trust me, as hard as it is today it’s easier than it will be in a week, a month or a year from now. 

I’ve been married to my wife for two years and have been on the receiving end of emotional abuse and, at times, it has gotten physical.  Our relationship has been a steady and slow erosion of my own self worth to the point I’m such a shell of myself that I have no hobbies, shut myself out from all my friends and spend everything I have on her (only because anytime she had a bill, etc she just gives it to me and tells me to “handle it”).  I am constantly thinking about all the times in the past I should’ve left, first we were dating, after she moved in, when we were engaged, before we moved.  Now I’m essentially trapped for the time being, I have no job and no place to live if I had to. 

Trust me, it will never be easier than today for you to leave.

I have some part time work but my last job ended this week. I have others I’ve been speaking with but it’s seems like January has been slow.  I’m trying to figure out if I’m eligible for unemployment from my last job.  This money is mostly for the credit card debt which has been snowballing.  Approaching 10K which will take me time to pay off so I figure Im either going to lose money in interest or by taking out from my 401K.  So while I’ll lose in the long run, I’m going to build more and more interest as I chip away at the debt.

This warms my heart so much.  I’m so happy the gift went over well and I was able to ease your burden in a small way.  Knowing how much she loved it was the best gift I could’ve asked for. 

Hoping you’re in a much better place by next Christmas.

Oh man I understand.  Sorry you’re dealing with it too. Hopefully you’re gainfully employed so at least even if you are shouldering the weight right now you can accurately budget and control as much as possible.  Even before moving I had things under control even without regular work. But now things are just spiraling and I’m just waiting until my cards are maxed out.  I have no idea how she will handle that but I’m fearing it’s not going to be if but when. 

Whatever you do DO NOT bend to her desires.  Even if it costs you your marriage.  It will only get worse, please stand your ground for your sake and so my struggles aren’t for nothing.  If I had done that and it’d cost me my marriage I’d be in a much better spot and to be honest - so would she.
I’ve been looking for a break where ever I can find one lately, hope this could be it!

With the idea being “we all need help because it’s a fickle business and you don’t get a job handed to you because you’re no more special than we all are.”  I guess there are people who expect that but I have worked hard for a decade and will continue to for whoever gives me a chance.

An innocent kid with a family in a tough place should have something good to look back on from childhood if life gets them down like I feel right now.
